# nosuchmachine.net — BLACKSITE

> nosuchmachine.net is a working penetration-testing bench and a web operating system, built by NIGHTWARE LABZ. It is a tool, not a brochure: everything on the site runs in the visitor's browser or at the site's guarded edge. Doctrine: one knock, read, grade. Public targets only — private, loopback, and reserved addresses are refused before contact.

## The site

- [BLACKSITE OS](https://nosuchmachine.net/): a windowed operating system in a browser tab — the nightjar Blacksite console ported to the web. Real shell, persistent virtual filesystem, 427 commands, eight programming engines (Python, JavaScript, Lua, SQLite, Scheme, Brainfuck, WebAssembly, CHIP-8), git and SSH clients, EMCON gating, the thinice theme and generated wallpapers. Every icon in the OS is a drawn house mark (no emoji anywhere), windows snap to halves and maximize by drag or Alt+arrow keys, every open window is registered as a real desk process with a pid on the Processes board, and the launcher carries desk actions (tile, cascade, close all).
- [Bench suite](https://nosuchmachine.net/bench/): BLACKSITE WEB — DNS resolution across three resolvers, hand-rolled TLS inspection, HTTP security grading, TCP connect checks, RDAP/CT domain recon, email security grading (SPF/DMARC/DKIM/MTA-STS), subdomain census, a PQC migration scanner, JWT inspection and HS verification, an AES-GCM vault, a certificate decoder, codecs, subnet math, and a session report with JSON/Markdown export.
- phantom: an OS inside the OS. The operator's own phase1 (v7.0.1, Rust) compiled to WebAssembly and running in BLACKSITE with its real shell, scheduler, and VFS — operated through a guest-machine console: a state rail (raising, boot menu, running, halted), an honest spec plate, wake/halt power, and quick keys that send real lines.
- AEGIS: the OS carries an immune system — self-snapshots, a mutation circuit breaker, decoy canary files, and a mirage filesystem that ransomware exhausts itself encrypting while the real room restores untouched. The `aegis` verb and the System panel run it.
- phonehome: a secure transmitter and reception field built into BLACKSITE OS — point-to-point telecommunications between two stations: tap-to-talk voice (one tap on, one tap off) on WebRTC's encrypted media path and text sealed station to station (ECDH + AES-256-GCM under signed identities). The site's rendezvous swaps signed connection signals only (ten-minute TTL, deleted on link-up) and never hears the link. No phone numbers or SMS — a browser has no telephony radio, and the window says so.
- Relay: a real IRC client built into BLACKSITE OS (OFTC, Libera.Chat, hackint over TLS via the site's bridge). The community channel is #nosuchmachine on OFTC — no account or registration: opening Relay drops visitors straight into the room wearing issued machine names (machine1A, machine2D, and on without end). Libera.Chat currently refuses bridged guests (it demands SASL from the bridge's network range). House names (nightwarelabz, nosuchmachine, chasebryan and kin) are claimed and open only with the operator's claim code.
- [Orange Book](https://nosuchmachine.net/book/): the book of Orange, a programming language for specifying, implementing, and verifying cryptography — 24 chapters, free to read.
- [Projects](https://nosuchmachine.net/projects/orange/): the NIGHTWARE LABZ catalog — nightjar (the native iOS/macOS network instrument this site ports), orange, snoot (a post-quantum crypto inventory scanner), Magic Box, and more.

## Rules of the house

- Network probes run only against public targets; the edge guard refuses private, loopback, link-local, and reserved space before any packet.
- The bench reads and grades. It does not exploit, spray, brute-force, or flood.
- Tools that cannot honestly run in a browser are named limits, never faked.
